## Version and environment / 版本与环境

- App version and full commit / 应用版本与完整提交：
- Date and timezone / 日期与时区：
- OS, browser, and runtime versions / 系统、浏览器、运行时版本：

## Procedure / 步骤

Provide commands or manual steps and identify the input fixture. / 请提供命令或人工步骤及使用的示例。

## Expected and observed / 预期与观察

## Evidence / 证据

Attach logs or link the CI run. Include failures and skipped checks. / 附日志或 CI 链接，列出失败与跳过项目。

## Limits / 结论边界

Do not generalize a workflow check to scientific validity or a different platform. / 不要把流程检查推广为科研可靠性或另一系统已验证。
